title: Danny Sheehan says he has coordinates for an underwater UFO base
place_text: Off Baja California / Guadalupe Island area

tellings.quote: he said that he has coordinates for a UFO underwater base.

plain: In 2024 the lawyer Danny Sheehan said he had map coordinates for an underwater UFO base, placed in the tellings off Baja California near Guadalupe Island. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels he heard Sheehan say it ('he has coordinates for a UFO underwater base'), which, if true, would put a hidden non-human base in the ocean off Mexico.
